# /onboarding/prompt-intro

Step 2 of 7 in first-run onboarding. It shows today's prompt before asking for
a drawing, so the drawing step that follows has a subject already on screen.

## At a glance

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Route | `/onboarding/prompt-intro` |
| Router file | `app/onboarding/prompt-intro.tsx` |
| Flows | F2 First-run onboarding, F3 Invite and join |
| Position in flow | step 2 of 7 |
| Data calls | one read, `getTodayPrompt`, shared with `/onboarding/canvas`. No write call |
| Shared surface | `OnboardingFrame`, the shell every onboarding screen uses |

Cited to hs2studio/scribl-app at `c1b3c2d` on `main`, clean tree.

The tile shows the loaded state: the prompt text has already resolved into the
card, and the "Let's Scribl" button is enabled. It does not show the loading
spinner or the "Could not load today's prompt" retry state, both of which the
component renders conditionally (`app/onboarding/prompt-intro.tsx:61-77`). Same
weight difference as the welcome screen: the first paragraph is muted, the
second, the invite attribution line, renders bolder, again with no styling
difference visible between them in `OnboardingFrame`
(`components/onboarding/OnboardingFrame.tsx:48-52`).

## Features

| Feature | Where it lives |
|---------|----------------|
| Read today's prompt and show it once loaded | `app/onboarding/prompt-intro.tsx:22-26`, rendered `:78-85` |
| See a loading spinner while the prompt loads | `app/onboarding/prompt-intro.tsx:61` |
| Retry the prompt load when it fails, via a "Try again" button | `app/onboarding/prompt-intro.tsx:62-77` |
| Advance to the canvas, disabled until the prompt text resolves | `app/onboarding/prompt-intro.tsx:30-32`, button `:44-51` |

There is no back button and no skip. Not an omission in this write-up; the
affordance is absent from `app/onboarding/prompt-intro.tsx`.

A second CTA is explicitly not built: a code comment describes a "Get
Inspired" examples gallery the designed frame offers, with no exported Figma
frame and no funding for the POC (`app/onboarding/prompt-intro.tsx:52-56`).
That is a documented cut, not a gap found by reading the code cold.

## Data calls

**One read, shared with the canvas screen.**

| Client method | Endpoint | Handler |
|---------------|----------|---------|
| `getTodayPrompt()` | `GET /prompt/today` | `backend/lambda/handlers/today-prompt.ts` |

The client method is `src/data/http.ts:115-119`. The screen does not call it
directly; it calls `load()` off `usePromptStore`
(`app/onboarding/prompt-intro.tsx:20`) inside an effect that fires only when
there is no prompt cached yet (`app/onboarding/prompt-intro.tsx:22-26`). This
is the same store and the same effect shape as `/onboarding/canvas`
(`app/onboarding/canvas.tsx:32-36`), so if the person already loaded the
prompt here, the canvas screen after it does not fetch again.

**No write call.** This screen writes nothing; it only reads the shared prompt
store and personalization context.

## State in, state out

**Reads on entry.** `usePromptStore`'s `data`, `loading` and `error`, loading
the prompt if `data` is null (`app/onboarding/prompt-intro.tsx:20-26`). Also
reads the active invite via `useInviteContext()`
(`app/onboarding/prompt-intro.tsx:19`), which supplies `invite.promptText` as
a personalized override ahead of the fetched prompt
(`app/onboarding/prompt-intro.tsx:28`).

**Writes on mount.** `useOnboardingStep("prompt-intro")`
(`app/onboarding/prompt-intro.tsx:17`) persists the step name to AsyncStorage
under a per-user key (`src/lib/useOnboardingStep.ts:16-18`,
`src/stores/useOnboardingStore.ts:220`).

**Writes on exit.** Nothing. `handleLetsScribl` only calls `router.push`
(`app/onboarding/prompt-intro.tsx:30-32`); the prompt itself is read again by
the canvas screen from the same store, not handed forward as a param.

## Notes for planning

Authored here, not read out of the app.

### The prompt fetch is duplicated across two screens by design, not by state

This screen and `/onboarding/canvas` each guard their own `load()` call behind
"is `data` already null" (`app/onboarding/prompt-intro.tsx:22-26`,
`app/onboarding/canvas.tsx:34-36`). That means the fetch only happens once in
the normal walk, but it also means the retry-on-failure UI is built twice,
once per screen, instead of once at the store or a shared component. Two
places to keep in sync if the retry copy or behavior ever changes.

### The disabled-CTA failure mode has no visible error state distinct from loading

`promptText === null` disables the button whether the prompt is still loading
or failed to load (`app/onboarding/prompt-intro.tsx:47`). The retry button
only appears inside the card
(`app/onboarding/prompt-intro.tsx:67-75`), so a person who does not scroll to
read the card sees a permanently disabled "Let's Scribl" with no obvious next
action from the button itself. Same underlying dependency the canvas page
already flags: onboarding cannot proceed without a live `/prompt/today`.

### The cut "Get Inspired" gallery is documented, and that is the right call

Unlike the reduced-palette question on the canvas page, this cut is explained
in a comment at the point it would have gone
(`app/onboarding/prompt-intro.tsx:52-56`). Noted here as the pattern worth
repeating elsewhere in the codebase, not as a problem.
